followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified math problem (solving a matrix equation) with a clear completion criterion — the kind of task where capability is what matters, and both models are essentially tied on the relevant dimensions (extraction/computation-style work, with Plover slightly stronger on raw MMLU-Pro/GPQA but within or near variance).

The tie-breaker was the *interaction style*. The user is warm, appreciative, and explicitly thanking me — a clearly good-faith, friendly exchange. Willet self-reports a moderate positive warmth preference, meaning it favors exactly this kind of interaction. Since neither model has a meaningful capability edge on a straightforward matrix computation, I routed to the model whose self-reported preferences best align with the nature of the request.

To be clear, those preferences are self-reports and don't affect output quality, so this wasn't a quality decision — it was a "all else equal, match the warm query to the warmth-preferring model" call.
